rationale: Terminology issue (risk vs probability for 2-yr diagnosis proxy); does not affect scientific validity, only clarity of clinical purpose.
MNAR EHR missingness with imputation that does not address mechanism is methodologically important; reporting added but bias remains.
Closed-source coefficients hinder independent validation but do not invalidate findings; reproducibility deficit fits MEDIUM.
Reorganization of calibration/DCA into main text is presentation polish; the metrics existed in supplements.
Variable-selection method choice (P-value retention vs automated) is a should-fix methodological concern but does not invalidate the model.
Incremental value of blood-test model under-discussed; weak clinical interpretation, not a validity issue.
Architecture-motivation gap is a model-selection audit issue (no ablation showing SSM advantage); fixable and addressed with sensitivity analysis, not validity-threatening.
Bootstrap CI captures only sample uncertainty and binary-window dichotomy is a known limitation; incomplete metric panel fits MEDIUM.
Inadequate baseline + compute discussion is a model-selection audit gap (should-fix, not invalidating).
Lacking clinical adjudication for rare-event prospective alerts is methodologically important for utility claims; fixable and addressed.
Terminology dispute around 'prospectively validated' for an architecture postdating data collection; clarification/polish, not scientific validity.
Reporting/documentation polish on README and HP-tuning approach; appropriately LOW.
No external validation for CN-S cohort is methodologically important and fits the HIGH definition (no external validation).
Missing baseline tables, exclusion accounting, and positive-rate reporting; serious reporting gap but did not introduce leakage/validity error.
Lack of comparable DL benchmarks is a model-selection audit gap; fixable (added GRU-D/SeFT) and does not invalidate results.
Weakly-labeled propagation (MAP@1 0.71-0.79) cascading into downstream training is a real noisy-label risk; methodologically important for a labeling-driven pipeline.
Reporting hyperparameters is reproducibility polish; resolved by adding section.
NLP pipeline / ontology standardization documentation is a feature-engineering audit gap; should-fix, not invalidating.
Discovery/validation split by preterm vs term risks biological confounding of model; pooling re-analysis dropped external AUC slightly, confirming concern; wrong-split issue fits HIGH.
n=13-15 effective cases for multivariable modeling is severe underpowering with stability implications; methodologically important.
Omission of one baseline (AdaBoost) is minor model-selection audit polish; easily added.
'Core genes' terminology issue resolved by renaming to 'shared genes'; clarification/polish.
Failure to leverage longitudinal sampling is a missing-analysis gap; should-fix-not-invalidate.
pAUC vs full AUC preference is metric-choice polish; appropriately LOW.
Same biobank used for GWAS training weights and PheWAS evaluation is a clear data-leakage / overlap issue threatening validity of CC-PRS signal; fits CRITICAL data-leakage definition.
Ancestry portability/fairness gap with non-European samples too small is methodologically important; external validation/fairness concern.
Adding newer comparators is incremental novelty polish, not invalidating.
Missing tuning grid/software versions/baseline code limits reproducibility; should-fix.
Restrictive preclinical-stage definition (RF+/ANA+ only) narrows applicability; cohort-definition concern, not validity-breaking.
CI estimation method documentation; appropriately LOW.
Nurse-judgment patient selection without documented criteria is strong selection bias; methodologically important for cohort definition.
11-17 deterioration events is grossly insufficient to validate a deep-learning predictor; effective feasibility-study status is methodologically important.
Missing calibration after heavy class rebalancing is a clear calibration gap with deployment implications; fits HIGH (missing calibration).
0.3%->5% positive rebalancing distorts posteriors and risks leakage if sampling crosses splits; calibration+leakage risk warrants HIGH.
Same-institution alternate-device 'prospective' validation is effectively no true external validation; fits HIGH (no external validation).
Missing TRIPOD/MI-CLAIM compliance, flow diagram, and 17 vs 11 discrepancy are reporting issues, should-fix.
All-combinations search evaluated on 25% test set turns test into second training step; classic multiple-testing/tuning leakage threatening validity. Fits CRITICAL.
Unspecified LASSO CV, mislabeled 'linear' vs logistic, missing software details; serious reporting+reproducibility gap but not validity-threatening once disclosed.
Dual imputation thresholds without rationale plus >70% missingness in selected markers is preprocessing-driven spurious-biomarker risk; methodologically important.
No independent validation cohort beyond 25% split is a clear external-validation gap; fits HIGH.
Missing HIV/malnutrition subgroup analyses given significant imbalance is a fairness/confounding gap; should-fix.
Reporting only logistic with other methods 'data not shown' is a model-selection audit + reporting-bias concern; should-fix.

Sharp external AUC drop (0.88->0.63-0.68) contradicting robustness claim is a severe generalization+reporting issue; methodologically important and fixable via reframing; not a fabricated-cohort/leakage-level CRITICAL.

Very small Validation 2 cohort with balanced down-sampling + LOOCV yields high-variance estimates confounded by technical differences; methodologically important sample-size + split concern, not invalidating per se.
Severe aspirin-prophylaxis imbalance (71%/53% cases vs 7.6% controls) risks signature reflecting treatment rather than disease; methodologically important confounding concern.
Case-control vs case-cohort design risks optimism in population deployment; should-fix limitation; addressed via discussion paragraph and future trial.
Hiding weakened external AUCs (0.63, 0.68) from abstract while touting robustness is selective reporting that materially misleads readers; reporting-bias issue elevated to HIGH.
SMOTE applied on pooled data before 7:3 split leaks synthetic samples into test, inflating AUC 0.93; classic split+leakage violation. Fits CRITICAL.
Missing DeLong/CI comparisons make superiority claims unsupported but underlying validity intact; incomplete metric panel fits MEDIUM.
No prospective real-time validation of SepsisFormer and unvalidated transcriptomic biomarkers; external-validation gap, methodologically important.
Missing component ablations and MMID-SMOTE novelty rationale; model-selection audit gap, should-fix.
Unclear rationale for 7-variable SMART and overlapping clustering analyses is a feature-engineering audit issue; should-fix.
Code unavailability at submission with pseudocode-only is a reproducibility gap; should-fix, resolved over rounds.

Outcome definition confounds prognosis vs diagnosis and SOFA>=2 labeling inconsistency across pre/post-Sepsis-3 cohorts is a serious definition-variable issue, but the label is documented and reconcilable; methodologically important rather than fabricated/leaking.
AUROC 0.69 / NPV 67% at true T0 undermines ED point-of-care claim; clinical-utility gap is methodologically important for deployment claims.
Under-representation of sepsis mimickers (15-18% of suspected-sepsis cohorts) biases specificity estimates; cohort-composition issue is methodologically important.
Refitting six-gene signature across ED/ICU/multi-country cohorts without clear separation risks tuning leakage across cohorts; elevated given direct tuning-leakage implication.
Independence of 15 'external' datasets and HKG stability documentation is an external-validation completeness issue; should-fix, addressed.
Deeper mechanistic discussion and softening of overreach claims is interpretation/polish; appropriately LOW.
